title: Renames event type that triggers on automatic updates
summary: Renames the payment_method.card_automatically_updated event type to payment_method.automatically_updated.

migrationNotes.text: By renaming the event type from payment_method.card_automatically_updated to payment_method.automatically_updated, you can now use the event for any type of payment method that has been automatically updated. This provides a more generic and flexible way for you to handle these updates in your applications.
